projects.name: Dial Bot
projects.summary: A meeting assistant shaped by a small product team.

tasks.title: Meeting journey
tasks.focus: Review the first-time attendee path in a real meeting.

detail.stateDetail: Working — host entry observed; attendee and spoken journey still need review.
detail.nextProof: Review the attendee's first visit and Bot motion in a real meeting, then complete a spoken exchange after audio repair.
detail.blocker: The attendee review and full spoken exchange remain open.
detail.evidence: The host's saved choice brought a silent Bot into local rooms; a signed-out attendee saw the optional introduction.

tasks.title: Public story
tasks.focus: Align the public story with the agreed meeting experience.

detail.stateDetail: Open — public wording still needs to match the agreed source-sharing rule.
detail.nextProof: Correct the public explanation of meeting-shared sources and verify the published copy.
detail.blocker: Current copy still describes a narrower questioner-only rule.
detail.evidence: The sharing rule is documented, but the full participant connection is not implemented.

tasks.title: Attendee introduction
tasks.focus: Verify the optional first-time introduction in a live join.

detail.stateDetail: Working — optional introduction observed; more attendee paths need review.
detail.nextProof: Prove trusted Bot presence before join and review the signed-in and repeat-visit paths.
detail.blocker: Prejoin detection and participant setup need further development.
detail.evidence: A signed-out attendee saw the optional in-room introduction; Amit's review remains open.

tasks.title: Bot presence and motion
tasks.focus: Review listening, thinking, and speaking in a real room.

detail.stateDetail: Ready for test — Listening seen live; other visual states await live review.
detail.nextProof: Review the Bot tile at both sizes and observe real Thinking and Speaking transitions.
detail.blocker: Visual acceptance and live speaking-state proof remain open.
detail.evidence: The solid Listening shape moved in a live room; other states have only code and preview checks.

tasks.title: Bot joins and stays present
tasks.focus: Repeat host choice and Bot join across fresh rooms.

detail.stateDetail: Working — local Bot presence observed; broader reliability remains open.
detail.nextProof: Repeat automatic join across fresh and returning rooms, then prove recovery, controls, and one Bot only.
detail.blocker: Normal audio and repeatable multi-room behavior remain open.
detail.evidence: Automatic join and a later manual invite were observed locally; join-timeout recovery is still awaiting live proof.

tasks.title: Host controls
tasks.focus: Verify invite, pause, resume, and remove.

detail.stateDetail: Working — simpler copy passes isolated checks; active integration open.
detail.nextProof: Integrate the simpler idle label and verify invite, pause, resume, remove, and Explore.
detail.blocker: The isolated copy change is not yet integrated; loading and full-screen speed remain unverified.
detail.evidence: Focused Settings and host-control checks passed in an isolated build.

tasks.title: Meeting identity
tasks.focus: Check room labels with different participants.

detail.stateDetail: Working — incorrect External label reproduced; correction open.
detail.nextProof: Show that a host plus Bot remains Internal while a real outside attendee changes the room to External.
detail.blocker: Room classification still needs implementation and live verification.
detail.evidence: The room label behaved incorrectly during a local review.

tasks.title: Questions and answers
tasks.focus: Prove a grounded answer and follow-up.

detail.stateDetail: Working — local helpers exist; full live proof open.
detail.nextProof: Demonstrate an attributed, evidence-backed live answer and follow-up with measured timing.
detail.blocker: No repeatable full live answer has been recorded.
detail.evidence: Local research helpers exist; live correctness remains to be checked.

tasks.title: Shared and personal context
tasks.focus: Check group and personal questions use intended context.

detail.stateDetail: Open — multi-person source routing is not yet available.
detail.nextProof: Test group and first-person questions using two people's selected sources, including revocation.
detail.blocker: Meeting-shared behavior awaits multi-person implementation.
detail.evidence: The current prototype still uses host-local research.

tasks.title: Assistant connections
tasks.focus: Document supported setup paths.

detail.stateDetail: Working — local assistant setup exists; broader setup paths remain open.
detail.nextProof: Document supported assistant setup routes and a per-source fallback.
detail.blocker: Assistant setup across supported environments remains unverified.
detail.evidence: A local assistant-tool probe exists.

tasks.title: Participant source controls
tasks.focus: Prove opt-in and revoke in a real meeting.

detail.stateDetail: Open — participant sharing and revocation need end-to-end work.
detail.nextProof: Build the participant sharing controls and verify opt-out and revoke in a real meeting.
detail.blocker: Participant sharing controls are still in development.
detail.evidence: The current connection flow is an interaction preview.

tasks.title: Speaker attribution
tasks.focus: Test two-person question capture.

detail.stateDetail: Working — mixed audio exists; trusted two-person proof open.
detail.nextProof: Capture complete questions from two people with trusted speaker identity.
detail.blocker: Two-person speaker attribution remains unproven.
detail.evidence: Mixed room audio was exercised; attribution proof is pending.

tasks.title: Voice playback
tasks.focus: Prove complete audio and interruption.

detail.stateDetail: Working — placeholder speech exists; managed voice proof open.
detail.nextProof: Demonstrate complete speech, interruption, and an approved natural voice in a real room.
detail.blocker: No approved managed voice connection is configured yet.
detail.evidence: The current voice is a placeholder; adapter contract checks used mocks.

tasks.title: Audio reliability
tasks.focus: Verify quiet join and clean playback.

detail.stateDetail: Open — repeating noise heard live; cause unknown.
detail.nextProof: Isolate and fix the tapping, then prove quiet join, pause without disconnect, and clean answer audio.
detail.blocker: The cause of the repeated tapping has not been isolated.
detail.evidence: The noise was heard live; stopping the local companion silenced it but also removed the Bot.

tasks.title: Sharing
tasks.focus: Confirm a safe delivery experience.

detail.stateDetail: Blocked — recipient-scoped delivery is not proven.
detail.nextProof: Verify recipient-specific link delivery and what a later joiner can see.
detail.blocker: Recipient-specific delivery has not passed review.
detail.evidence: Link sharing remains limited while its audience is checked.

tasks.title: Meeting controls
tasks.focus: Review notice and retention experience.

detail.stateDetail: Open — retention, notice, and action enforcement need decisions and proof.
detail.nextProof: Decide retention and notice behavior, then prove enforcement and action confirmation.
detail.blocker: The participant notice and after-meeting controls still need product decisions and proof.
detail.evidence: The intended behavior is documented; the end-to-end experience is unverified.

tasks.title: Team-ready runtime
tasks.focus: Prove operation beyond one local machine.

detail.stateDetail: Open — team-ready hosted operation remains to be proved.
detail.nextProof: Demonstrate a team-ready hosted setup beyond one local machine.
detail.blocker: A shared hosted setup is not available yet.
detail.evidence: The current version runs locally.

decisions.title: One visible Bot
decisions.detail: The host decides whether Bot joins; attendee setup is optional.

decisions.title: Each person chooses sources
decisions.detail: Participants choose meeting-shared sources and can turn sharing off.

decisions.title: Group and first-person questions
decisions.detail: Group questions may use active shared sources; first-person questions stay with the speaker.

decisions.title: Read answers and actions
decisions.detail: Read answers need no per-answer host approval; account actions require owner confirmation.

decisions.title: Optional attendee introduction
decisions.detail: The first-time introduction cannot block joining.

decisions.title: Truthful Bot motion
decisions.detail: Listening, Thinking, and Speaking visuals must follow actual events.
